data.headline: Director of Infrastructure & Cybersecurity | PhD Student at Boise State University | Architecting and Securing the Cloud | Site Reliability, DevOps, and Infrastructure Engineering
data.about:
I am a technology specialist with unique experience in areas like software development, web service deployments, microservices, and APIs. I specialize in cloud architecture (particularly AWS), cloud security, and “serverless” cloud technologies (ie Lambda, DynamoDB, Fargate, etc). 

Originally I started my career focused on marketing, specifically leveraging technology to improve the effectiveness of marketing efforts and conversions. I deployed complex marketing automation workflows, advanced tracking, and fingerprinting techniques to improve ROI for my employers. Eventually, around 2016, I became uncomfortable with the privacy monster that I had participated in creating. That is when I decided to shift my career into using technology for good and focusing on security.

I believe that the future is in the cloud and I am focused on helping companies transition to the cloud and improve security and automation along the way. I am knowledgeable in many programming languages including PHP, Python, and Javascript. I have used these to create integrations and even entire software tool stacks to improve productivity and effectiveness of my efforts. This background in fullstack web development and advanced programming makes me unique among IT engineers.

In 2017, I started a YouTube and education network to help teach other people about today’s modern software, technology strategies, and implementation. I teach students about how to program, script, automate, and more. I have received stellar reviews from students for my ability to communicate clearly and teach effectively. Some of these education materials have now been published by Packt Publishing and LinkedIn Learning. The community boasts over a million collective video views, tens of thousands of written tutorial page views per month, and over 100,000 subscribers across email and YouTube.

I am interested in new opportunities involving Cloud, Security, and DevOps. Please feel free to reach out to me for exciting hiring opportunities or for DevMarketer sponsorships.

description.text:
Brown Box is a grocery delivery company that leverages technology to provide same-day grocery delivery from local artisans and farmers. As a system administrator, I ensured that all aspects of technical operations for the business went smoothly including warehouse technologies, printing services, phone systems, web servers, and much more.

◉ Deployed new driver tracking and customer notification system which was rated by customers as the #1 favorite feature in a 2020 internal customer survey

◉ Wrote and enforced new security policies for improved management of passwords, SSL certificates, DNS changes, 2-factor authentication, and other security practices.

◉ Implemented, installed, and managed a Linux server cluster for running 3CX PBX phone system on AWS EC2 infrastructure. This self-hosted PBX migration reduced PBX expenses by over 90% from the previous SaaS solution, while adding new features and capabilities.

◉ Initiated, wrote, and instituted a documentation program for all main tech procedures and standard troubleshooting. This lead to a 60% reduction in help desk tickets and a 50% faster time-to-resolution of remaining tickets.

◉ Migrated from manual deployment methods to Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in order to automate the deployment of ALL web services. This was first built using Cloudformation in early 2020, but I later converted it to Terraform in late 2021.

description.text:
Yagi is a unique ISP that provides internet to homes and businesses when other internet providers are not available. As a Network Engineer, I helped engineer these custom connection solutions depending on the specific need of each business. These might include Point-to-point wireless, custom fiber, or cellular links. I also managed ongoing maintenance of these systems and uptime management.

◉ Maintained 99.9% SLA for internet uptime to client stations with zero SLA violations for 2 years straight

◉ Spearheaded the launch of "AirFiber", a new long-distance point-to-point internet service offering. Projects included vendor selection, testing, procedure creation, and monitoring integration

◉ Improved internal monitoring and notification system by building connections using serverless functions (AWS Lambda) to improve customer experience, automation, and product cohesion

◉ Managed the deployment of a 32 node outdoor campus wifi network for a State Park, which services over 1,000 devices per day.

Rocky Mountain Oils sells direct-to-consumer essential oil products using e-commerce. My role as marketer proudly established impressive year-over-year growth during my tenure. I directed a full marketing staff of graphic designers, product experts, SEO and PPC, web developers, email and copy writers, and more.

◉ Managed a team of 12 direct reports including hiring, coaching, and termination

◉ Created budget reports amid substantial growth periods and stayed within budget parameters

◉ Surpassed marketing sales goals every year

◉ Launched two new inter-departmental corporate initiatives for “customer service & product education”, and “product quality & branding”. Both programs exceeded revenue goals during their respective years.

◉ Developed and launched two new sub-brands Tohi and Essential Health, including the introduction of over 30 new products

◉ Orchestrated a complete rebuild of the ecommerce website platform to Magento Enterprise. This includes work with technical and design teams to coordinate the launch.

PanX Solutions created experimental technology that provided accurate indoor tracking for dense buildings and structures. Developed as a safety solution for employees, security guards, and emergency response workers that needed to be tracked within dense highrise buildings where GPS technology doesn’t traditionally work. This tracking technology can work in dense buildings, high interference campuses, and even underground.

I was responsible for public relations, early adoption, and brand development of these products. I worked to successfully sign up several large hotel chains and hospitals to use these products for employee safety programs and asset management.
